parts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, photographic fashion product atlas recolour. Primary target reference1 is an existing SIX-frame 3-column x2-row atlas of ONE MiloShopHand Cloud Pullover Hoodie. Preserve exactly the six poses, camera directions, body outline, hood shape, relaxed sleeve position, seams, kangaroo pouch, cloth folds, relative scale, placement and pale ivory studio background. Change ONLY the garment colorway to BLACK: deep soft black cotton fleece #151515, coordinated black rib cuffs/hem, black hood binding and black drawcords. Keep premium photographic fabric texture and natural soft lighting highlights, not flat black silhouettes, shiny plastic or low-poly 3D. There must be NO olive/green or cream trim left on the garment. Brand ink changes to crisp WHITE: small interwoven ML chest monogram when visible, and floral M plus exact MiloShopHand back emblem/wordmark when visible. Strong white-on-black contrast. White logo is flat ink, no glow, no new rectangle or patch. Reference2 is the garment's original front/back identity and detail; reference3 is the exact white floral logo (ignore its burgundy backdrop). No added lettering, no person/mannequin/hanger/support.
Output retains exactly SIX equal portrait cells in an edge-to-edge3-column x2-row grid, 6:5 overall aspect ratio,1374x1145 or larger, at least450pixels per cell. No gutters/gridlines/borders/labels/numbers. Product stays perfectly upright, every frame rotates only around verticalY axis; fixed level camera, no tilt, roll, up/down orbit or pose changes. Preserve the precise angle sequence of reference1, not six new attractive front views. Exactly the same physical black hoodie and branding in every frame.
Reference1 ordered views are0,15,30 degrees top row,45,60,75 degrees bottom row (front toward first side). Keep these exact six views: first fully straight FRONT, last nearly LEFT SIDE. White frontML naturally foreshortens and disappears around side; do not show back print on front.
